title: Lesson 49: Security Architecture: Network, API Gateways, WAF, and Data Loss Prevention for AI
description: Security architecture is the enforcement layer that turns governance commitments into controls. An agent is an application on a network, so it has a perimeter, a request path, and data flows, each of which is a place to block, filter, or inspect. The network layer shapes inbound traffic and stops volumetric abuse, the API gateway is the choke point for identity and quotas, the web application firewall catches cheap known attacks at the edge while semantic guardrails catch what surface text misses, and data loss prevention governs the sensitive content that moves inside prompts, tool calls, and outputs.

questions.question: Why can a web application firewall not serve as a complete semantic safety layer for an AI application?
options: It inspects only the response body and never the incoming request at all
It cannot be deployed in front of a model endpoint
It matches text patterns, not meaning, so rephrased attacks slip past it
It already enforces the authentication the gateway provides
questions.explanation: A firewall reads surface text, not meaning, so paraphrased or encoded injections evade its rules. Catching those requires a separate control that interprets the prompt.

questions.question: Why must data loss prevention watch what an agent sends through outputs and tool calls, not only what a user types?
options: Sensitive data also leaves through responses and tool calls
User input is never sensitive enough to require any inspection
Tool calls travel outside the network and bypass every control
Outputs are encrypted, so they need separate decryption first
questions.explanation: Sensitive content can leave through what the model returns or what a tool call forwards, so guarding only the request side leaves the other half of the flow open. The control must cover the full data path.

questions.question: Which set of controls belongs at the API gateway rather than at the network edge?
options: Volumetric rate limiting and strict request size limits
questions.explanation: The gateway is the single choke point where identity is verified and per-identity policy is applied. Volume controls like rate and size limits belong earlier, at the edge.
